svg.aria-label: Project constellation. Project 01 Workforce Contribution Monitor links to software, data and machine learning. Project 02 Satellite Water Quality links to machine learning, data and geospatial analytics, and shares its domain with the IEEE ICCPCT 2026 paper. Project 03 AI Customer Feedback Intelligence links to NLP, agentic AI, software and data. Public GitHub repositories link to software.
